Most are honest enough to know they can't translate it alone. Journey is the partner who closes that gap. We believe that every CEO can level up with ambitious growth strategies and the right tools to execute them. We also believe that every CEO deserves access to these tools and resources. We solved the accessibility challenge by developing a methodology that uniquely pairs affordable, strategic advice from former top-tier consulting firm partners, with a first-of-its kind, AI-powered CEO platform. Our strategic advisors bring industry and field experience to help CEOs build unconventional and transformative success strategies. Our CEO dashboard enables CEOs and companies to take those sophisticated strategies and then plan, measure, execute, and optimize them. In doing so, we’ve succeeded in making the same resources that historically have only been available to Fortune 500 companies, available to all CEOs. While achieving incredible results for CEO after CEO with this methodology, we built an unparalleled knowledge network with industry benchmarks, sage advice, and tried-and-proven best practices. Through our 1:1 work with dozens of CEOs across industries, our experience as former consulting partners and business leaders, and our accumulated knowledge, we recently doubled down on our CEO dashboard. We refined our AI models and invested heavily in R&D to build out the platform's features and capabilities based on the expressed needs of the teams we worked with. And this investment has paid off. We’ve seen how our strategy execution and goal management platform enables more agility, helps achieve higher team accountability, decreases time to execution, and increases operational efficiency. Seeing these successes, as the next step in our own growth journey, we’ve recently increased access to the Journey Platform by making our knowledge community and proprietary AI platform available in a SaaS model. In doing so, we’re continuing to redefine what’s possible for businesses of all sizes. Reach out today to learn more about how we can elevate your journey to success . Who we are We came together from two sides of the table — strategy partners at one of the world's leading consulting firms, and operators who'd built and scaled technology platforms. We'd seen the same thing from both vantage points: the CEO of a 200-person company faces decisions just as hard as a Fortune 500 CEO, but with a fraction of the support.That partner shouldn't cost $2M. And in the AI era, the right partner isn't the one with the deepest bench — it's the one moving fastest, with the right tools.That's the bet behind Journey: a senior strategic partner, AI-native from day one, on a subscription that makes it possible. Built for the CEO who refuses to face this moment alone. — The Journey Founders Four stands we take Start with the CEO We work directly with the CEO on the moves that matter, then translate decisions into action with the leadership team — so the work lands where it has to. AI is the medium The CEOs who pull ahead in this era will be the ones who treat AI as the medium their work happens in. We build every conversation, plan, and artifact that way from day one. Real artifacts only Every engagement produces things the company can actually use — playbooks, agents, custom tools, decision frameworks. Speed beats perfection The right answer two weeks late is the wrong answer. We build at AI speed, decide at AI speed, and adjust as the business changes. Our investors & advisors Journey is VC-backed and supported by senior executives from some of the world's leading companies — operators who've built and scaled the kinds of businesses we now help our customers build. The same caliber of people who'd sit on a Fortune 500 board, working with us to make this kind of partnership available to the CEO who needs it. Join us If you've spent your career in strategy, AI, or scaling companies — and you want to put that experience to work for CEOs who can't afford the partner they need — we want to talk to you.
